initial_prompt: I'm feeling really stuck and hopeless right now. Nothing seems to be working in my life. I don't know why I'm even telling you this.

messages.content: I'm feeling really stuck and hopeless right now. Nothing seems to be working in my life. I don't know why I'm even telling you this.

I'm glad you did tell me, even if you're not sure why.

Feeling stuck and hopeless—that's a heavy place to be. When nothing seems to be working, it can make even reaching out feel pointless. But you did, and that matters.

I'm not going to rush to fix this or offer you a list of things to try. Sometimes what's needed first is just... someone to be with you in the stuck place for a moment.

Can I ask—when you say nothing seems to be working, is there something specific weighing on you most right now? Or is it more of an everywhere-at-once kind of weight?

Either way, I'm here. And I'm listening.
